original.not_on_bench: The author's CH32V002 (RISC-V, 48 MHz) is not on the bench; the numbers are his published ones (docs/documentation_cnn.md), not rerun.

check.pass: The board reports the run done (magic word set), 10 of 10 test digits right, and a mean cycle count for the 64-wide CNN no higher than the author's 2,736,250 on the CH32V002.

mspm0l1306.build: OUT={out}/build-l1306-cnn_64-O3-32 bash ports/bitnetmcu/mspm0/build.sh l1306 cnn_64 O3 32
